### Ziff Davis to Participate in Two Investor Conferences in September


August 18, 2026


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Ziff Davis, Inc. (NASDAQ: ZD), today announced its participation in two investor conferences in September.


Details of the conferences are as follows:


**2026 Citi Global TMT Conference** Location: New York, NY
Date and time: September 9, 2026
Webcast: No formal presentation


**Benchmark-StoneX’s 13th Annual TMT Conference** Location: New York, NY
Date and time: September 17, 2026
Webcast: No formal presentation


**About Ziff Davis**


Ziff Davis (NASDAQ: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, health and wellness, cybersecurity, and martech. For more information, visit[www.ziffdavis.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ziffdavis.com&esheet=54590086&newsitemid=20260818290419&lan=en-US&anchor=www.ziffdavis.com&index=1&md5=bed87fdff578cabc22a536045092ab6d) .
